description: We are a team of motivated, creative, and ambitious individuals who are passionate about science, technology, innovation, and helping people. We believe that technology can make healthcare more accessible, efficient, and reliable, especially for people living in remote or underserved areas. Through the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we want to combine our ideas, creativity, and technical skills to develop a meaningful solution that can make a positive difference in people's lives.
summary:
For the NASA Space Apps Challenge (Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions), our team developed an innovative, user-centric health monitoring platform designed to safeguard astronaut wellbeing during deep-space missions. Our solution features a comprehensive web application that tracks vital physiological metrics in real time, leveraging intuitive data visualization to help crew members and flight surgeons instantly detect anomalies, fatigue, or stress.
​To bridge complex biomedical telemetry with human-centered engagement, we integrated a custom-crafted comic narrative directly into our web platform, making health guidelines and software navigation accessible and engaging. Furthermore, we built a streamlined demo presentation highlighting our core architecture, real-world utility, and seamless user experience.
​This project is crucial because long-duration spaceflight exposes astronauts to severe physiological degradation, from cardiovascular deconditioning to psychological stress. By combining proactive health tracking software with narrative-driven UI elements, our solution ensures rapid response times, reduces cognitive load on crews, and bridges the gap between complex diagnostics and daily operational usability - ultimately supporting safer, more resilient human exploration beyond Earth.
details:
What it does & how it works:

STARTIME+ is a smart health-monitoring app built for astronauts on long space journeys like a mission to Mars. It connects to wearables to track key vitals in real time-like heart rate, ECG, oxygen levels, sleep, and daily activity. The AI creates a personal health baseline for every crew member, quickly spotting any anomalies or unusual changes. If an issue comes up, the app instantly sends alerts with clear recovery steps and shares secure medical reports with doctors on Earth.

Benefits & Intended Impact: Because communication with Earth is delayed in deep space, astronauts need reliable onboard tools to stay safe. STARTIME+ helps them catch health issues early, manage fatigue, and stay mission-ready throughout the entire flight.

Creativity & Team Considerations:We designed this solution around real space challenges: isolation, body changes in microgravity, and delayed comms. To bring our idea to life, we created a custom sci-fi comic about astronaut Alex, which you can view here: https://canva.link/sthexhf4uv4qx72

Tools & Technologies Used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vite, Vercel, Canva.
